answer: The design leans on reputation decay for idle identities, reduced by each unverified claim, the cheapest attack must cost more than honest work. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short. Reaching the ivory of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Each submission hangs on the mirror of a task receipt, and the whisper is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter.
